name: Detailed Meeting Notes
description: Everything that happened: points with their answers, questions and answers, steps of a demo, how the work flows, decisions and who does what.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: A short paragraph: what the meeting was about and what came out of it

sections.title: Key Points
sections.instruction: The main points, in the order they came up, one bullet each. When a point got an answer, a result or a conclusion, write it right after the point as: point - answer. Use the screen only to say what a speaker pointed at

sections.title: Questions & Answers
sections.instruction: Every question that was asked, and the answer that was given. A question can be spoken, or shown on screen and then answered by a speaker. Write Not answered when there was no answer. Use the speaker's name if known and the time of the question

sections.title: Steps / Demo
sections.instruction: If something was demonstrated or a procedure was explained, the steps in order as a numbered list, each with what was done or shown at that step and its time. Write None noted in this section. when nothing was demonstrated or explained step by step

sections.title: Work Flow
sections.instruction: How the work moves, only as the speakers described it: which task comes first, what depends on what, and who hands what to whom (e.g. Design by Asha -> review by Ravi -> release). Write None noted in this section. when nobody described it

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: Decisions the speakers made, with the reason if one was given and the time

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every task someone was given or took on: the owner, the task, the due date if one was said, and the transcript segment and time where it was said. Only tasks a speaker said
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
